name: shiftnurse
description: Nurse scheduling desktop app with union rule compliance, acuity-driven staffing and fairness scoring

scripts.watch:packages: concurrently -n core,db -c cyan,magenta "npm run watch -w @shiftnurse/core" "npm run watch -w @shiftnurse/db"
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n pkgs,app -c gray,green "npm run watch:packages" "npm run dev -w @shiftnurse/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @shiftnurse/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @shiftnurse/desktop --
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc --build --force && npm run typecheck -w @shiftnurse/desktop
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.bench:solvers: npm run build:packages && vitest run --config vitest.bench.config.ts
